name: listing.transactionId
title: Field: listing.transactionId
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.transactionId field.
text:
# listing.transactionId

TL;DR:
- listing.transactionId links the current authenticated user to a related transaction for this listing.

What it means:
- A non-null value means the current user already has a transaction relationship around this listing.
- Null means no related transaction exists for the current user in the current context.

Agent hint:
- Treat this as actor-specific workflow state, not as a global property of the listing itself.
